intro: Solara transforms your bedroom into a retreat. With its quilted headboard, angled back, and soft upholstery, it invites you to lean back, relax, and savor unhurried moments of rest every night.

features.title: Angled headboard that supports you
features.text: Unlike flat designs, the gently sloped back reduces strain on shoulders and spine, so you read, watch, or relax without discomfort

features.title: Quilted back for comfort and style
features.text: Generously padded and upholstered, the headboard feels soft to lean on, while cross-quilted patterns bring depth and a tailored look

features.title: Ample underbed storage for all your needs
features.text: A spacious storage base keeps bedding, cushions, or seasonal items hidden yet handy, helping your room stay neat and uncluttered

features.title: Pebble brown finish that warms interiors
features.text: Synthetic leather in pebble brown adds earthy richness, blending beautifully with different wardrobes and bedside tables

name: Solara King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
